Based on my analysis of the network traffic and alerts, here is the incident report:

---

## INCIDENT REPORT

**Case ID:** MTA-2024-11-26  
**Analysis Date:** 2024-11-26  
**Capture File:** 2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap  

### COMPROMISED HOST DETAILS

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **IPv4 Address** | 10.11.26.183 |
| **MAC Address** | d0:57:7b:ce:fc:8b |
| **Windows Hostname** | DESKTOP-B8TQK49 |
| **Logged-in User Account** | oboomwald |
| **Network** | 10.11.26.0/24 (Local Enterprise LAN) |

### MALWARE IDENTIFICATION

**Family:** NetSupport Manager Remote Access Trojan (RAT)

**Attribution:** Signature-confirmed via multiple Suricata/ET PRO alerts:
- ETPRO TROJAN NetSupport RAT CnC Activity (Event 3.4022)
- ETPRO TROJAN Malicious NetSupport Rat CnC Checkin (Event 3.4023)
- ET INFO NetSupport Remote Admin Checkin (Event 3.4025)
- ET INFO NetSupport Remote Admin Response (Event 3.4027)

**Version Detected:** NetSupport Manager/1.3 (User-Agent header)

### INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE (IOCs)

#### Command and Control Endpoints

| Type | Indicator | Port | First Contact | Frequency |
|------|-----------|------|---------------|-----------|
| IP:Port | 194.180.191.64:443 | 443 | 08:50:45 UTC | Every 60 seconds |
| C&C URL | http://194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm | 443 | 08:50:45 UTC | Beaconing |
| Geolocation Service | geo.netsupportsoftware.com:443 | 443 | 08:50:45 UTC | Once |
| GeoLocation IP | 104.26.1.231:80 | 80 | 08:50:45 UTC | Once |

#### Malicious Domains

| Domain | Query Type | First Seen | Purpose |
|--------|-----------|-----------|---------|
| modandcrackedapk.com | DNS + TLS SNI | 08:50:14 UTC | ZPHP malware distribution, cracked software hosting |
| classicgrand.com | DNS | 08:50:11 UTC | Suspicious domain |
| confirmsubscription.com | DNS | 08:50:14 UTC | Phishing/social engineering |

#### C&C Communication Protocol

- **Protocol:** HTTP/1.1 over TCP/443 (unencrypted HTTP wrapped over TLS connection)
- **Method:** POST
- **User-Agent:** NetSupport Manager/1.3
- **Content-Type:** application/x-www-form-urlencoded
- **Commands Observed:**
  - CMD=POLL (polling for commands)
  - CMD=ENCD (sending encrypted payload data)
- **Response Format:** NetSupport Manager protocol with encoded/encrypted payloads
- **Beacon Interval:** Approximately 60 seconds after initial check-in

#### Network Exploitation Activity

| Technique | Target | Port | Alert |
|-----------|--------|------|-------|
| SMB Session Setup NTMLSSP Unicode Overflow | 10.11.26.3 (Domain Controller) | 139 | GPL NETBIOS SMB Session Setup NTMLSSP unicode asn1 overflow attempt |
| [MS-EFSR] EFS RPC Exploitation | 10.11.26.3 | 445 | ETPRO POLICY [MS-EFSR] Microsoft Encrypting File System Remote Protocol Activity |
| SMBv1 Protocol Usage | 10.11.26.3 | 139 | ET INFO Potentially unsafe SMBv1 protocol in use |
| SMB IPC$ Share Access | 10.11.26.3 | 139 | GPL NETBIOS SMB IPC$ unicode share access |
| SMB COM_TRANSACTION DoS | 10.11.26.3 | 139 | GPL NETBIOS SMB SMB_COM_TRANSACTION Max Data Count of 0 DOS Attempt |

#### Timeline of Key Events

| Timestamp (UTC) | Event |
|-----------------|-------|
| 08:49:38 | Initial network startup, connectivity tests, LDAP queries to domain |
| 08:49:55 | SMB reconnaissance and exploitation attempts via port 445 (EFS RPC) |
| 08:50:10 | SMBv1 exploitation attempts via port 139 |
| 08:50:14 | DNS query for modandcrackedapk.com (malware distribution site) |
| 08:50:40 | TLS SNI query for modandcrackedapk.com to 193.42.38.139 |
| 08:50:45 | **Initial C&C check-in to 194.180.191.64:443** |
| 08:50:45+ | Regular beaconing to C&C every 60 seconds with encrypted payload exchanges |

### THREAT ASSESSMENT

**Severity:** Critical

**Rationale:**
- Active remote access trojan with confirmed C&C communication
- Exploitation of domain controller (10.11.26.3) via SMBv1 and EFS RPC vulnerabilities
- Lateral movement attempts (IPC$ share access, NTMLSSP overflow)
- Encrypted command and control for evasion
- Access to sensitive network resources via authenticated domain account (oboomwald)

**Secondary Indicators:**
- Downloads from modandcrackedapk.com (cracked software/malware hosting site) confirm intentional malware acquisition
- Continuous beaconing indicates persistent threat with remote control capability
- Geolocation lookup suggests reconnaissance for C&C adaptation

### CONCLUSION

The Windows workstation DESKTOP-B8TQK49 at 10.11.26.183 is actively infected with NetSupport Manager Remote Access Trojan. The malware is actively beaconing to a command and control server at 194.180.191.64 with 60-second check-in intervals. The compromised account oboomwald is being used to probe and exploit the domain infrastructure, specifically targeting the domain controller at 10.11.26.3 via SMBv1 and RPC protocols.

Immediate containment and eradication are required.
